note: Read 2026-10-30. The regulation on driving licences and instruction (Kunngerð nr. 129 frá 26. september 2018 um koyrikort og koyrifrálæru, on logir.fo) says a licence for category B may be given to someone who has turned 18 (§ 14). Akstovan's renewal page says a licence for categories AM, A, B and B/E is issued for 15 years, at most until the holder turns 75; its fees page (rendered in a browser, its table being built in script) gives the issue of a licence for every category but mopeds at 250 kr., the fee held, and a first category B driving test at 550 kr., not held. The identity card is not this office's. No exchange list was read.

sources.title: Kunngerð um koyrikort og koyrifrálæru (nr. 129, 26. september 2018), logir.fo
sources.said: § 14. Koyrikort til bólk B, bólk B/E, bólk C og bólk C/E kann verða latið persóni, ið hevur fylt 18 ár.

sources.title: Akstovan, Endurnýggjan av koyrikortinum
sources.said: B (persónbil) og B/E (stórt viðfestiakfar til persónbil) og koyrikort til traktor ella motoramboð verður útgivið við gildi í 15 ár, tó í mesta lagi til handhavin hevur fylt 75 ár.

sources.title: Akstovan, Gjøld (rendered)
sources.said: Útgáva av koyrikorti til allar bólkar uttan prutl 250 ... B persónbilur fyrsta roynd 550
